title: M3Hop-CoT: Misogynous Meme Identification with Multimodal Multi-hop Chain-of-Thought
reasoning: The paper includes a significant component evaluating the model's ability to reason through religious and mythological contexts to identify misogyny. Specifically, it analyzes cultural references including historical beliefs about the Church in the 1500s, Christian interpretations of the Bible, and Japanese mythology as part of its rationale generation and error analysis.
